text: My office has been working with City staff and local residents around traffic calming and safety on Ordnance Street. Following a request from a nearby resident, we solicited feedback from residents in local affected condo buildings on Ordnance Street through property management and received over 100 responses to an online survey hosted by my office. A majority of respondents to the survey were in favour of speed humps on their street. I’m looking forward to advancing these improvements to improve safety at a key intersection in our downtown, and to continue working with residents on improvements in their neighbourhood.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Authorized the installation of traffic calming (three speed humps) on Ordnance Street, between Strachan Avenue and the south end of Ordnance Street, generally as shown in Attachment 2 to the letter (July 6, 2026) from Deputy Mayor Ausma Malik.
